== Description ==

[[Daniel Amor]] (left, olive-green hoodie, glasses), [[Scott Lingrell]] (right, white hair, glasses, navy Lincoln Financial pullover), and [[Nathan Russell]] (back left, dark grey Mario 8-bit tee, glasses, balding) at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 3 October 2025.
